name: Ricaurte (Cundinamarca, Colombia)
description: White field with a red triangle from the upper hoist to the lower fly along the top edge.
history: Municipal flag of Ricaurte, Cundinamarca, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: triangle along the top edge from the hoist to the lower fly
